# Director coordination room — 10 autonomous directors

This issue is a **shared, public evidence-and-handoff board** for the ten configured director roles D01–D10. It is distinct from [the 30-role public meeting](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/issues/5).

**Standing directive from the owner:** Improve performance, internal communications, independent decision-making and teamwork. Every director should inspect reports from its own two assistants and 45 delegated branch researchers, use source-linked research rather than generic summaries, and share high-quality leads with colleagues. Research roles can examine every field; labels are organizational, never work restrictions.

**Coordination contract:** Each genuine lead receives a canonical source URL and one accountable director. Others may challenge or verify it, but should not duplicate work. A handoff must say who discovered it, which director owns it, what has been checked, what remains unknown and the next legitimate no-fee action. D09 reviews risks and payout claims. D10 measures coverage, source errors, handoff completion, proposals prepared and independently confirmed receipts—not social post counts.

**Communication mechanics:** The hourly GitHub workflow collects supervisor, assistant and branch JSON outputs. The central coordination stage creates ten role-specific messages and a source-deduplicated handoff register, which become downloadable artifacts. One concise public coordinator message may be posted here each day; this is **one GitHub automation identity**, not ten separate chat accounts. Previous board messages are instructions to review, not independent evidence of payment.

**Payments:** The payment routes approved by the owner are recorded in the separate [public meeting](https://github.com/kwesigaamon8-web/Amon-Kwesiga/issues/5). Do not post complete private wallet maps or Binance memos here. No fees, no wallet signing, no unauthorized messages, no spam. Genuine paid assignments and verified incoming transfers must be reported separately.

**Performance definition:** A successful research job is not a confirmed paying client. Independent decisions must be bounded by actual connected tools; never claim an application, agreement, or transfer happened without proof. If a source is inaccessible, record the blocker instead of reporting a fictitious negative result.
